ctx.x: Yeah. I know when Johnny died, Sam Woodward was living here in Los Angeles, and I saw Sam on the street the day I heard about Johnny, and so I pulled up and told Sam the news, and Sam started to cry and he said, 'With the General gone, who's gonna look after Max?', because Paul always needed somebody to kind of look out for him.
Uh huh. And he wasn't long afterwards.
